summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom of reading the verses of Birkat Kohanim in Parashat Naso. He reviews the practice in various communities and reads a letter from Haham Shaltiel explaining the tradition in Aleppo.
questions: What is the custom for reading Birkat Kohanim in Parashat Naso in Middle Eastern communities?
What did Haham Shaltiel write in his letter about the custom in Aleppo?
Which Aliya is used for the verses of Birkat Kohanim according to the tradition of Aleppo?
Why is Aliya Shishi considered important according to the Mekubalim?
